text:
A neutral atom consists of electrons orbiting a nucleus. The nucleus contains protons and
neutrons.
Which statement about the atom must be correct?
A
The number of electrons is equal to the number of neutrons.
B
The number of electrons is equal to the number of protons.
C
The number of neutrons is equal to the number of protons.
D
The number of electrons, neutrons and protons are all different.

options.label: A
options.text: The number of electrons is equal to the number of neutrons.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of electrons is equal to the number of protons.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of neutrons is equal to the number of protons.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of electrons, neutrons and protons are all different.
